Develop future leaders through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and targeted capability development. Strong executive presence with the ability to influence customers and senior stakeholders and navigate complex, high-stakes situations. Proven experience leading complex customer escalations and making timely decisions in ambiguous environments. A strong track record of building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams across geographically distributed and matrixed organizations. Experience influencing and partnering effectively with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and other senior cross-functional leaders. Ensure timely resolution of queries and adherence to organizational policies and statutory requirements.
